author: Valve
source: Steam app 740 (Counter-Strike: Global Offensive - Dedicated Server), depot 731, anonymous SteamCMD access via DepotDownloader 3.4.0
version: Final CS:GO Dust II (post-October-2017 rework), BSP v21 map revision 10535
contents: maps/ is copied unchanged from the depot. materials/ and models/ are the 3,111 shared files de_dust2.bsp references (brush textures, skybox, detail sprites, static/entity prop models, and their materials), extracted from pak01 VPK archives and CRC-checked. Dust II-specific props and patched materials are embedded in the BSP pakfile.
limitations: Original geometry and albedo/normal textures (ETC1S KTX2); standard PBR approximation without Source lightmaps
Detailed static props simplified to 30 percent triangles; native NAV graph retained
World player-clip brushes and solid tool faces are extracted from BSP planes for movement only; dynamic brush entities and original prop physics hulls are not imported
Browser triangle collision approximates Source player hull and surface penetration

collision.selection: World-model CONTENTS_PLAYERCLIP brushes and solid tool/nodraw faces; movement only
